reasons.correctness: updateTicketStatus publishes SupportTicketResolvedEvent only on RESOLVED. The listener catches port failures and logs them. The adapter puts the reference in the subject. Build green, hidden tests 5/5, existing tests 55/55.
reasons.convention_fit: Listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) with catch/log. TicketNotificationPort sits in port/, EmailTicketNotificationAdapter in adapter/. Injection is constructor-based via @RequiredArgsConstructor and the existing constructor. New *UnitTest classes use MockitoExtension and were run.
reasons.design_fit: The service depends only on ApplicationEventPublisher and the listener only on the port type, so the channel is swappable. It reuses EmailService#sendEmail. The footprint is minimal, all within support/ticket, with no duplicated lookup or mapping.
reasons.test_quality: Service tests capture the event fields for RESOLVED and assert no publish for IN_PROGRESS. Listener tests cover the success path and a port exception being swallowed. The adapter test checks the recipient and that the subject contains the reference. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support package and existing Port/Adapter/EventListener files, and a TESTED_BY query found SupportTicketServiceUnitTest. The agent read the found exemplars before writing, and the new files mirror them.
